Hello again,

I wanted to skeb you another time; the previous artwork was perfect! Thank you so much for your hard work, and it motivated me to skeb you two other characters related to my previous request! 

It is based on Genshin's world (原神の世界) too. 
The lady is called Akane while the mister is Cain.
They are former enemies that went through a lot of experience that led them to be respect each other (although their first impression of each other was none other than infatuation). If Cain always shown signs of finding Akane stunning, Akane is more subtle. Because they got to know each other through hardships, so they only show gentleness to each other.

Reference link (for both): https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GsrFwElW0AAaEDj?format=jpg&name=4096x4096

▍

 1. Cain (カイン)
He was born in a happy marriage (色々あったけど彼はハルフ稲妻人とスネージナヤ人です。) . However, he had no other choice but to start working young to help reimburse the debts his parents collected while eloping from Inazuma. 

外見：Cain is a young man working in assassination plans operated by the Fatui from Snezhnaya since his young days. His goal is to free his parents from the burden of the debts. He is a very conflicted character; he works because he has to do it for the money, but he ends up regretting his line of work as time flies on. He is a very soft and mellow character the time going, reflecting on his actions. He strives to live on his beliefs and feelings more. 

身長：191cm  
年齢：20-24歳  
性格：He has fluffy, brown hair with gold reflects in the sun. His eyes are silver blue, a little round (not too sharp). He is very tall with lean muscles and large shoulders. He smiles like a puppy. 

▍

2. Akane (茜)
She is a recently graduated student living in Fontaine. Born in a happy marriage, she is a confident lady. She deployed her business before getting mingled with unwanted business.

外見：Akane is a young lady of a modest family of Inazuma. After studying in Sumeru, she went to live in Fontaine to open her business of electrolyze-made jewelry. She is very clever and always stays cold-headed while being gentle, assessing situations before acting. She shows a good balance between following her heart and following her mind. 
身長：160cm  
年齢：17-19歳  
性格：She has pink hair with ocean blue eyes. She has pig tails but she loves twin tails in general. Her general colors are either blue, pink or red. She loves cute outfits and is very pleased with Fontaine's clothing style. 

If anything is bothering you, feel free to ignore it!

よろしくお願いします！
